RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_CLASS.law: lower class cannot self-promote; direct Founder/current controlling authority and valid chronology govern conflicts

CLAIM_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT.FOUNDER_LOCK: direct Founder decision or governing persisted Founder-lock evidence
CLAIM_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT.STORY_GATE_PASS: gate artifact/result under controlling project authority
CLAIM_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT.AUTOMATED_TEST_PASS: exact code/test identity + invocation + exit/count/log evidence
CLAIM_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT.PROVIDER_EXECUTED: real provider job/response/output identity; dry-run insufficient
CLAIM_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT.HUMAN_APPROVED: actual human response + exact stimulus/build + method/date

RECOVERY_WRITE_TRANSACTION.law: no accepted material write is complete until readback; stale precondition triggers rebase

RECOVERY_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.law: same key under compatible current authority => NO_OP/DUPLICATE; changed authority => reconcile

promotion_boundary: These contracts are sprint outputs. They become CURRENT only through normal candidate/pilot/regression/application/readback lifecycle.
